title: VRU Trajectory Dataset
citation: Zernetsch, S., Kress, V., Bieshaar, M., Reitberger, G., Fuchs, E., Doll, K., & Sick, B. (2022). VRU Trajectory Dataset. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6303669

files.transformation: Preserve the publisher archive unchanged. If a future descriptive adapter is added, it must identify each CSV trajectory by archive path and retain timestamp, x, and y coordinates in their published seconds and metres units.

supported_primitives: Source-locked descriptive 2D pedestrian head-position trajectories from one urban intersection; useful only for clearly labeled out-of-domain structural exploration.
exclusions: Not an empirical benchmark source, calibration source, station or interchange proxy, body-dimension source, queueing source, route-choice source, information-behavior source, evacuation source, population profile, or safety evidence.
